title: 第7章 人和人的差距第8章 老师的关心
content_zh:
公交车上。
拥有了羽书之后，张羽本以为自己未来的生活会是羽书！让我看看你的极限在哪里！
哪知道转眼就变成了……仪式张羽！让我看看你的极限在哪里！
但事已至此，张羽想要解除仪式的力量，他唯一能想到的路子就是让自己变得更强。
于是他此刻也只能努力修行。
只见张羽一呼一吸之间，天地间的灵机一缕缕地涌入他的体内，汇聚到丹田气海之中，被一点一滴地提炼为法力，夯实着他的仙道基础。
不过想到昨天晚上练习健体三十六式的过程，张羽便想要如法炮制，看看能不能把基础吐纳法也迅速提升级别。
只见羽书随着他心念一动而展开，接着张羽的注意力向书页上的‘基础吐纳法1级’稍稍集中过去，立刻就将‘基础吐纳法1级’拖动了起来。
但就在他将‘基础吐纳法1级’拖向自己的人物画像时，一丝明悟从羽书中涌出。
“一次只能专注于提升一个技能。”
“切换一次，就要等待一天时间才能再次切换。”
张羽心中将羽书的这项功能取名为专精。
这一刻，他一下子明白被专精的技能可以得到快速提升，但一段时间里只能专精一项技能，切换技能后要等一天时间才能再次切换。
“也就是说如果我现在把专精从健体三十六式切换成基础吐纳法的话，那接下来基础吐纳法可以通过练习而快速提升，但是健体三十六式又会恢复原本正常的练习效率。”
“除非一天之后，我再把健体三十六式切换回来……”
想到体育课上的情况，张羽便决定暂时不做切换，继续以提升健体三十六式为主。
转眼间时间过去，张羽便维持着基础吐纳法，直到下车前的那一刻。
……
学校食堂内。
白真真端着餐盘，来到宛如行尸走肉般的张羽面前坐下，好奇地看了对方一眼，淡淡道“昨天导了一晚上？”

张羽一口吞下手中的大肉包，骂骂咧咧道“老子是用功锻炼到了深夜。”
白真真脸上面无表情，嘴上却毫无顾忌道“唉，全校就你没做绝育手术了，早就劝你别节约那两万块钱，看看你浪费了多少时间，多少精力，多少蛋白质？”
张羽又一口吞掉一颗鸡蛋，自信一笑道“白真真，告诉你一件事情，我现在的自律和潜力连我自己都感觉到心惊，你这年级第一的宝座要不了多久就会被我抢下来的。”
白真真闻言却是快速翻了个白眼，秀气的小嘴说着毫不留情的话“羽子，这种不自量力的话在我面前说说就算了，给外人听到了我怕人家连尿都要笑出来啊。”
“你要争的是年级总分第一，不是年级导管第一，你没绝育的优势用不上。”
张羽无语地摇了摇头，心道“阿真这家伙，平时装得冷冰冰的，私底下什么都敢说是吧。”
说起全校学生就他没做绝育手术，张羽对此已经没那么惊讶了，他已经渐渐习惯了这破世界破学校的癫狂。
不过没绝育的事情仍旧是他的一个小秘密，同学之中张羽也只和白真真说过。
但此刻想到这点，张羽心中突然涌出一个疑惑“为什么我没做绝育手术就能入学？”
就在这时，周天翊也端着餐盘坐了过来，同样好奇地看向张羽“你看上去很累啊，昨天通宵学习了？”
张羽摇了摇头说道“稍稍练了一会儿健体三十六式，心中偶有所得。”
吃饭聊天时，张羽突然有了一个发现，似乎周天翊来了以后，白真真的话就少了许多，好像又变成了那个冷淡、话少的学霸。
吃完早饭，三人顺着操场一路走向了教室的方向。
张羽时不时张开手掌，看着羽书从自己的掌心浮现和消失。
“果然大家都看不见羽书吗？”
就在这时，却听砰的一声从教学楼的方向传来，然后又是一阵阵大呼小叫声响个不停。
只见教学大楼的正门前已经围了一圈人，一具脑袋开花的尸体正静静躺在地上。
content_en:
On the bus.
After owning Yu Shu, Zhang Yu originally thought that his future life would be Yu Shu! Let me see where your limits are!
Who would have thought that in the blink of an eye it would turn into... Ceremony Zhang Yu! Let me see where your limits are!
But the matter has come to this, Zhang Yu wants to remove the power of the ritual, and the only way he can think of is to make himself stronger.
So he could only practice hard at this moment.
As Zhang Yu breathed and breathed, the spiritual ideas from heaven and earth poured into his body one after another, gathered into the sea of ​​​​Qi in Dantian, and were refined into magic power bit by bit, consolidating the foundation of his immortal way.
However, thinking of the process of practicing the thirty-six bodybuilding exercises last night, Zhang Yu wanted to follow the same pattern and see if he could quickly improve the basic breathing method.
He saw Yu's book unfolding as he thought, and then Zhang Yu's attention was slightly focused on the 'Basic Breathing Technique Level 1' on the page, and he immediately dragged the 'Basic Breathing Technique Level 1' up.
But just as he dragged the 'Basic Breathing Method Level 1' towards his portrait, a glimmer of understanding emerged from the feather book.
“Only focus on improving one skill at a time.”
“When you switch once, you have to wait a day before you can switch again.”
Zhang Yu named this function of Yu Shu as specialization in his mind.
At this moment, he suddenly understood that the skills being specialized could be improved quickly, but he could only specialize in one skill for a period of time, and he would have to wait a day after switching skills before switching again.
"That is to say, if I now switch my specialization from the Thirty-Six Bodybuilding Exercises to the Basic Breathing and Breathing Method, then the basic Breathing and Breathing Method can be quickly improved through practice, but the Thirty-six Bodybuilding Exercises will return to the original normal practice efficiency."
"Unless one day later, I switch back to the thirty-six physical fitness postures..."
Thinking of the situation in the physical education class, Zhang Yu decided not to switch for the time being and continued to focus on improving the thirty-six postures for physical fitness.
Time passed in the blink of an eye, and Zhang Yu maintained the basic breathing method until the moment before getting off the car.
…
In the school cafeteria.
Bai Zhenzhen took the dinner plate and came to sit down in front of Zhang Yu who was like a zombie. He glanced at him curiously and said lightly, "You spent the whole night guiding?"
Zhang Yu swallowed the big meat bun in his hand and cursed, "I worked hard until late at night."
Bai Zhenzhen's face was expressionless, but he said without any scruples, "Oh, you are the only one in the school who has not had sterilization surgery. I have long advised you not to save those 20,000 yuan. Look how much time, how much energy, and how much protein you have wasted?"
Zhang Yu swallowed another egg in one mouthful and said with a confident smile, "Bai Zhenzhen, let me tell you something. My current self-discipline and potential scare even me. It won't be long before I take over your throne as the number one in my grade."
When Bai Zhenzhen heard this, he quickly rolled his eyes, and said mercilessly with his delicate mouth, "Yuzi, just say such overestimating words in front of me. If outsiders hear it, I'm afraid they will laugh even in the urine."
"What you are competing for is to be first in the overall score of the grade, not to be the first in the grade of catheter. Your advantage of not being sterilized cannot be used."
Zhang Yu shook his head speechlessly and thought to himself, "Azhen, this guy, usually pretends to be cold, but he dares to say anything in private, right?"
Speaking of the fact that he was the only student in the school who had not undergone sterilization surgery, Zhang Yu was no longer so surprised. He had gradually become accustomed to the madness of this world-shattering school.
However, the fact that he had not been sterilized was still a little secret of his. Among his classmates, Zhang Yu only told Bai Zhenzhen.
But thinking of this at this moment, Zhang Yu suddenly had a doubt in his heart: "Why can I enter school without undergoing sterilization surgery?"
At this moment, Zhou Tianyi also sat over with a dinner plate and looked at Zhang Yu with the same curiosity: "You look very tired. Did you study all night yesterday?"
Zhang Yu shook his head and said, "After practicing the thirty-six postures for a while, I felt likeOccasionally gain. "
While eating and chatting, Zhang Yu suddenly made a discovery. It seemed that after Zhou Tianyi came, Bai Zhenzhen talked a lot less, and seemed to have become the cold, talkative academic master again.
After breakfast, the three of them walked along the playground to the classroom.
Zhang Yu opened his palms from time to time and watched Yu Shu appear and disappear from his palms.
"As expected, no one can see Yu Shu? "
At this moment, I heard a bang coming from the direction of the teaching building, and then there were waves of shouting and screaming.
I saw a circle of people gathered in front of the main entrance of the teaching building, and a corpse with a blooming head was lying quietly on the ground.
